arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS online_over_2000_count FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' AND amount_usd_cents > 200000
arguments.explanation: Counts all online transactions whose amount is above $2,000, whether or not they carry a fraud label.
assumptions: The count covers all dates in the data (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31) and includes transactions with no fraud label.
No exclusion of negative amounts is needed, since the threshold is positive.
